correctness.rationale: For a circular repeated permutation P^k, q distinct labelled letters, t<=q deletions, every cyclic output V specifies gaps g_i by congruence g_i ≡ index(v_{i+1})−index(v_i)−1 (mod q) with sum t. For t<q each gap is uniquely determined by its residue and source placements differ only by whole-period shifts. For t=q exactly a single q-long deleted interval can have ambiguous 0/q gap, and all q phase-orbits of those intervals give [P^(k−1)] while every other output retains unique orbit preimage. Burnside on the cyclic k-period action yields (1/k)sum_{d|gcd(k,t)}phi(d)C(qk/d,t/d) minus q−1 only for t=q. Independent direct necklace canonicalization of all tested q=2..5,k=2..4,t<=q and orbit mask code inspection agree; universal classification follows gap uniqueness, not finite extrapolation.
residual_risks: t>q is outside the theorem and can have additional collisions; finite checks are not an all-q,k proof.
